description:
Documented application of a specific TasteRule to a scene or shot element.
Provides verifiable proof of compliance with the creative style system.

applied_value.description: The concrete setting or parameter applied (e.g., 'cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), 400ms')
applied_value.title: Applied Value

citation.description: Verbatim citation from the taste documentation proving alignment
citation.title: Citation

context_ref.description: Reference to the target scene or shot (e.g., 'scene_001_shot_002')
context_ref.title: Context Ref

decision_id.description: Unique identifier for this decision instance
decision_id.title: Decision Id

evidence.description: Verifiable context citations or trigger evidence
evidence.title: Evidence

reason_summary.description: Concise auditable rationale summary without hidden CoT
reason_summary.title: Reason Summary

reasoning.description: Explanation of why this value was chosen for this context
reasoning.title: Reasoning

rule_id.description: ID of the governing TasteRule applied
rule_id.title: Rule Id

rule_ids.description: IDs of all rules influencing this decision
rule_ids.title: Rule Ids

title: TasteDecision
